web.title: Post Acute Transitional Care Products - Elion Health
web.description:
# [ABOUT Healthcare](https://elion.health/products/about-healthcare)
Their services include managing acute patient transfers, post-acute patient discharges, and behavioral health placements.

# [AIDA Platform](https://elion.health/products/aida-platform)
AIDA Platform is a referral and care-coordination platform used during discharge and post-acute placement workflows.

# [Evolv Health](https://elion.health/products/evolv-health)
Their offering combines a platform called Sensys with dedicated care management teams to centralize post-acute care operations, automate discharge planning workflows, manage patient length of stay, and enhance collaboration with community providers.

web.title: Post-Acute Transitional Care: Bridging the Gap After Discharge | Elion
web.description: These tools are built specifically for post-acute handoffs, with focused workflows for reducing readmissions and managing high-risk discharges.

web.title: Radial Care Reviews, Pricing, Features & Integrations - Elion Health
web.description: ACOs, health systems, and payer care-management and clinical teams use it to guide discharge decisions, assign post-acute placements, and target interventions.
